kind: curated summary of independently reviewed experiments

raw_evidence.availability: Original raw receipts and large artifacts are retained in a private archive.
raw_evidence.note: This summary is not a substitute for model weights, raw run receipts or the original verification environment.

adapter_comparison.scope: Independently authored synthetic screen; not a real-traffic accuracy estimate.

compiled_cache_confirmation.scope: One repetition on previously exposed cases; dynamic input order then compiled reverse order. Request timer excludes tokenization and output decoding. Not image generation or Jetson latency.

compiler_restart.scope: Fresh Python processes with the same wrapper. Preparation follows dynamic/eager generation that warms the model and GPU; it includes generation and excludes model loading/merging. Not whole-service startup.
compiler_restart.causal_limit: Supports seed-sensitive graph reuse; does not isolate rotary ordering from all other hash-sensitive behavior.
